deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena

cards.power: The Empirical-Pounding. Moves medicine from Demon-Dances to recording Match-Data on trauma.
cards.lore: Established the first systematic approach to trauma, treating the body as a structure to be repaired through observation and craft.
cards.gradeReason: Name signals pioneer but needs context — ancient Egypt not immediate to all players.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Ibis-headed Egyptian physician writing on stone tablet. Mood: Ancient gravitas, first science.

cards.power: The Ethics-Anchor. Creates the Rules-of-the-Ring — the healer must serve the wrestler and do no harm.
cards.lore: Separated medicine from religion; argued that epilepsy was a natural Brain-Glitch, not a divine curse.
cards.gradeReason: Primum non nocere is universal — Oath-Bearer role is instantly embodiable at any table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Turtle philosopher in Greek robes holding caduceus, sunburst halo. Mood: Noble ethical authority.

cards.power: The Humoral-Lock. Defines the Four-Humor-Balance. His word becomes the undisputed manual.
cards.lore: Dominated medical thought so completely that for 1,000 years, no one dared to Dissect-the-Truth to see if his pig-based anatomy books matched the body.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect villain archetype — Dogma-King tells you exactly what to perform: the unchallengeable authority.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Boar king in Roman purple robes, balance scales with colored potions, throne of scrolls. Mood: Imperious dogmatic power.

cards.power: The Logic-Synthesis. Merges Greek-Style with Persian-Insight into the ultimate Combat-Manual.
cards.lore: Introduced Clinical-Trials and recognised that Bacteria-Punks could travel through air and water.
cards.gradeReason: Canon-Master is clear but Islamic Golden Age context helps unlock full performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Lion in scholarly robes, beams of light shooting from glowing open book in library. Mood: Intellectual synthesis, luminous.

cards.power: The Dissection-Strike. Smashes Galen-Dogma by physically opening the Wrestler-Body.
cards.lore: The birth of modern anatomy. Insisted the doctor must be the Observer, not just a reader of dusty books.
cards.gradeReason: Body-Snatcher + Dissection-Strike is instantly actionable — you cut, you correct, you win.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Raccoon anatomist revealing glowing skeleton under lamplight, Galen books in background. Mood: Transgressive revelation.

cards.power: The Chemical-Cure. Declares Life-Force is a series of Chemical-Matches needing Metal-and-Mineral allies.
cards.lore: Father of Toxicology. Moved medicine from Balancing-Humors to Targeted-Chemistry.
cards.gradeReason: Alchemist role is clear but the Paracelsus context helps; dose-makes-the-poison is the unlock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Goat alchemist with goggles holding green glowing flask amid fire and scrolls. Mood: Chaotic genius, chemical transformation.

cards.power: The Circular-Flow. Proves the Blood-River moves in a Closed-Loop with the heart acting as a pump.
cards.lore: Used math to prove the heart pumps more blood in an hour than the body weighs; blood is recycled, not consumed.
cards.gradeReason: Pump-Detective is immediately playable — you investigate, you map the circuit, you prove it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Dog in deerstalker coat inspecting heart-and-pipe plumbing system with magnifying glass. Mood: Detective clarity, eureka.

cards.power: The Invisible-Reveal. Opens the Micro-Arena, proving a world of tiny wrestlers exists beneath the surface.
cards.lore: Father of Microbiology. Revealed the invisible enemies hidden from human eyes since the beginning.
cards.gradeReason: Lens-Maker role is clear; van Leeuwenhoek less universally known but animalcule concept translates.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Mouse peering through enormous lens at glowing bubble full of cartoon microbes fighting. Mood: Wonder, hidden worlds revealed.

cards.power: The Armor-Transfer. Uses Cow-Pox-Gunk from immune milkmaids to give a Permanent-Shield.
cards.lore: Birth of Immunology. A Weak-Enemy can train the Immune-Army to defeat a Lethal-Monster.
cards.gradeReason: Cow-Guard + Armor-Transfer — you protect, you vaccinate, you guard the herd. Crystal clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Bull warrior generating blue energy shield around small calf, glowing protective aura. Mood: Protective heroism, first vaccine.

cards.power: The Silver-Clean. Realizes doctors carry Death-Particles; demands everyone Wash-with-Lime.
cards.lore: The Semmelweis Reflex. Mocked for suggesting doctors were killing patients. He found the truth but lacked the Lore-of-Bacteria to explain it.
cards.gradeReason: Wash-Outcast is a perfect tragic hero archetype — you know the truth, they mock you, you wash anyway.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Badger in top hat scrubbing hands at basin, silver light bursting, shadowy skeptics behind him. Mood: Vindicated outcast, tragic truth.

cards.power: The Clean-Arena. Proves Grit-and-Gunk kill more than bullets. Uses Stat-Maps to force sanitation.
cards.lore: Mother of Nursing & Statistics. The Healing-Environment (Light, Air, Clean) is as powerful as any chemical ally.
cards.gradeReason: Lamp-Light is instantly embodiable — you illuminate, you chart, you clean the ward. Iconic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Luminous moth-fairy carrying lantern through dark ward, statistical rose diagram glowing below. Mood: Radiant data-driven compassion.

cards.power: The Antiseptic-Mist. Uses Carbolic-Acid-Rain to kill Bacteria-Punks before they enter the Wrestler-Body.
cards.lore: Applied Pasteur's Germ Theory to surgery. Proved Rot (Sepsis) is an invasion from the outside.
cards.gradeReason: Spray-King is fun and playable; Pasteur connection gives context needed to fully unlock the role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Heron surgeon in apron wielding acid spray gun, green bacteria punks dissolving mid-air. Mood: Clinical authority, antiseptic warfare.

cards.power: The Gentle-Tie. Stops the Boiling-Oil-Torture; starts Tying-the-Pipes to stop bleeding without burning.
cards.lore: Realized Kind-Medicine leads to better Healing-Stats than Aggressive-Trauma-Treatment.
cards.gradeReason: Wound-Stitcher is clear but Ambroise Paré is less universally recognized — needs brief intro.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Bear field surgeon stitching glowing red artery amid battlefield smoke, cannonballs in background. Mood: Gentle precision amid chaos.

cards.power: The Pain-Mute. Puts the Wrestler into a Deep-Sleep, allowing the Blade-Brigade to work without screams.
cards.lore: Birth of Anesthesia. Turned surgery from a 3-Minute-Sprint-of-Horror into a Precise-Technical-Art.
cards.gradeReason: Dream-Maker + Pain-Mute = total clarity. You put them under. No screams. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Sloth anesthesiologist in top hat dispensing purple dream-smoke to patient, surgeons working calmly behind. Mood: Merciful dreamspace.

cards.power: The Trial-by-Fire. Insists surgeons must be scientists, even infecting himself to study Match-Progression.
cards.lore: Moved surgery from Barber-Shop-Craft to Academic-Science via Comparative-Anatomy.
cards.gradeReason: Experimentalist is clear but John Hunter's self-infection legend needs setup to land fully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Magpie surgeon surrounded by specimen jars, holding bone up to light in cluttered anatomy lab. Mood: Obsessive scientific curiosity.

cards.power: The Sterile-Barrier. Introduces gloves to protect his Tag-Team-Partner, accidentally creating the Gold-Standard-of-Clean.
cards.lore: Established the Halstedian-Principles: gentle tissue handling, perfect hemostasis, absolute Arena-Sterility.
cards.gradeReason: Gloved-Hand is tactile and clear; Halsted's principles need table orientation but the metaphor holds.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Fox surgeon in sterile gloves positioning chess pieces on surgical field under clinical light. Mood: Methodical sterile precision.

cards.power: The Targeted-Strike. Floods a Chemical-Dye that kills only the Syphilis-Spirochete without hurting the body.
cards.lore: Father of Chemotherapy. Proved Chemistry can be a Sniper-Rifle instead of a Shotgun.
cards.gradeReason: Magic Bullet is common parlance — laser-targeted healer archetype, no explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Eagle firing laser-thin chemical beam through colorful bacterial cloud, hitting only one target. Mood: Precision strike, father of chemo.

cards.power: The Fungal-Shield. Discovers a Blue-Mold that dissolves Staph-Bacteria-Punks, the first true antibiotic.
cards.lore: Found the Secret-Weapon nature used to fight its own Micro-Wars, bringing it to the human arena.
cards.gradeReason: Mold-Hunter = accidental discoverer archetype. Penicillin is cultural bedrock — instant recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Frog scientist staring bewildered at glowing blue-green mold cloud dissolving bacteria characters in petri dish. Mood: Accidental miracle.

cards.power: The Sugar-Unlock. Extracts the Secret-Key (Insulin) so Diabetic-Wrestlers can use their Sugar-Tokens.
cards.lore: Turned a Lethal-Waste-Match into a Chronic-Match. Sold the patent for $1 to ensure every wrestler got the key.
cards.gradeReason: Key-Finder is perfect metaphor — and the $1 patent story makes this a moral heavyweight too.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Husky scientist holding golden key, caged skeletal dog breaking free in golden light. Mood: Liberation, altruistic breakthrough.

cards.power: The Inflammation-Mute. Modifies Willow-Bark-Acid to be Stomach-Friendly, making a universal pain muter.
cards.lore: Birth of the modern pharmaceutical industry. A stable mass-producible Chemical-Ally for the common man.
cards.gradeReason: Aspirin-Maker is clear but Hoffmann's specific role needs brief context — willow-to-pill chain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Beaver chemist feeding willow bark through industrial machine churning out aspirin tablets. Mood: Industrial warmth, accessible medicine.

cards.power: The Transparent-Wrestler. Discovers New-Light that passes through flesh but stops at bone, revealing Inside-Secrets without a cut.
cards.lore: Refused to patent it, calling it a Gift to Humanity. Opened the era of Diagnostic-Inference.
cards.gradeReason: Shadow-Catcher is perfect — X-ray as shadow magic is universal. Gift-to-Humanity adds moral weight.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Owl holding glowing X-ray film showing hand bones, astonished expression, dark lab background. Mood: Uncanny revelation, gift to humanity.

cards.power: The Atomic-Fire. Discovers elements emitting Constant-Energy used to Burn-the-Tumor-Miners from the inside.
cards.lore: Created Petites Curies (Mobile X-ray units) for WWI, bringing Shadow-Catching to the front lines.
cards.gradeReason: Radium-Queen is iconic — Marie Curie needs no introduction, queenly authority is instantly embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Firefly queen radiating blue-green atomic glow, vial of radium aloft in dark laboratory. Mood: Brilliant dangerous beauty.

cards.power: The 3D-Reconstruction. Uses Computer-Math to turn hundreds of X-ray-Shadows into a sliceable 3D-Virtual-Wrestler.
cards.lore: Transformed imaging from a Flat-Picture into a Volumetric-Map. Created the Donut of Truth.
cards.gradeReason: Slice-Master is evocative but Hounsfield/CT scanner needs table context — Donut of Truth helps.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Glowing octopus inside CT donut scanner, holographic brain slices floating around it. Mood: Volumetric revelation, clinical wonder.

cards.power: The Resonance-Map. Uses Massive-Magnets to make Water-Protons dance, revealing soft-tissue secrets.
cards.lore: Magnetic Resonance Imaging. Figured out how to turn Magnetic-Signals into Pictures-of-the-Mind.
cards.gradeReason: Magnet-Titan is strong but Lauterbur's specific MRI contribution needs orientation for non-scientists.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Rainbow-swirled rhino inside magnetic field rings, colorful soft-tissue images radiating outward. Mood: Invisible forces made visible.

cards.power: The Blueprint-Logic. Discovers the Invisible-Rules of how Traits pass from Coach to Rookie.
cards.lore: Father of Genetics. Heredity is not a Blending-of-Blood, but a Shuffle-of-Information-Packets.
cards.gradeReason: Pea-Priest is one of the deck's best names — monk + peas + math = instantly performable curiosity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Praying mantis monk surrounded by peas and mathematical formulae glowing in monastery garden. Mood: Quiet monastic revelation.

cards.power: The Master-Scroll. Reveal the Code-of-Life is a Twisted-Ladder that can unzip and Copy-Itself.
cards.lore: Found the Physical-Storage of the Source-Code. Unlocked the language of the A, T, C, G wrestlers.
cards.gradeReason: Double-helix is universal cultural knowledge — unzipping the ladder is immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Two monkeys holding and stretching apart a golden DNA double-helix, rosalind's photo in background. Mood: Triumphant discovery.

cards.power: The DNA-Megaphone. Takes a Single-Tiny-Code-Scrap and copies it millions of times until the Enemy-Name is loud.
cards.lore: Made Genetic-Testing fast and cheap. Allows us to find a Single-Virus-Punk in an ocean of blood.
cards.gradeReason: Signal-Copier is clear but PCR is specialist knowledge — the megaphone metaphor is the rescue line.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Parrot scientist feeding single DNA strand into steam-powered copying machine, millions of strands erupting. Mood: Amplification, joyful repetition.

cards.power: The Genetic-Scissors. Reaches into the Master-Scroll to Cut-out-a-Glitch, replacing it with a Healthy-Code-Line.
cards.lore: Era of Programmable-Medicine. We can now Edit-the-Wrestler to fix the Source-Code-Errors of the past.
cards.gradeReason: Genetic-Scissors is now universal post-COVID — CRISPR cutting is perfectly embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Cat scientist with safety goggles using giant scissors to cut glowing DNA strand, healthy replacement segment glowing nearby. Mood: Precise programmable power.

cards.power: The Source-Finder. Ignores Miasma-Ghost-Theory; maps Match-Deaths until they point to a single dirty pump.
cards.lore: Father of Epidemiology. Disease-Matches are won by Mapping-the-Data and Removing-the-Source.
cards.gradeReason: Map-Detective is perfect — you investigate, you map, you find the pump. Cholera story is legendary.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Bloodhound detective in top hat pointing at city map covered in red death-dots converging on one pump. Mood: Data-driven detective triumph.

cards.power: The Iron-Lung-Breaker. Creates a shield stopping the Polio-Paralyzer from taking over Muscle-Engines.
cards.lore: Could you patent the sun? Prioritized Global-Arena-Safety over personal Token-Profit.
cards.gradeReason: 'Could you patent the sun?' is an immortal line — moral clarity makes this instantly performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Elephant shattering iron lung machine with vaccine shield, small blue ghost-virus crushed beneath. Mood: Liberation, anti-patent heroism.

cards.power: The Rapid-Extraction. Uses Flying-Ambulances to pull wounded out of the Battlefield-Arena mid-fight.
cards.lore: Father of Emergency Medicine. Invented Triage, treating the Most-Injured first, regardless of rank or side.
cards.gradeReason: Flying-Ambulance is vivid and fun; Larrey not universally known but triage logic is clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Cheetah doctor driving horse-drawn blue-glow ambulance through cannon smoke, extracting wounded mid-battle. Mood: Urgent speed, battlefield mercy.

cards.power: The Vector-Slayer. Realizes the antagonist isn't swamp-gas, but the Mosquito-Drone carrying the incursion.
cards.lore: Cleaned the Arena-Environment, proving public health is about controlling the environment as much as the patient.
cards.gradeReason: Mosquito-Hunter is playable; Gorgas/Panama Canal context adds richness but not strictly needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Chameleon scientist swinging giant net at enormous glowing mosquito in jungle swamp. Mood: Environmental detective, vector logic.

cards.power: The Total-Engine-Swap. Takes a Healthy-Engine from a fallen wrestler and installs it into a new arena.
cards.lore: Proved the Body-Arena is modular. We can Swap-the-Parts to continue the Match-of-Life.
cards.gradeReason: Heart-Swapper is viscerally clear — the most dramatic surgery in medicine, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Baboon surgeon in scrubs holding glowing red heart aloft in dramatic surgical theater. Mood: Surgical triumph, modular body revelation.

cards.power: The External-Creation. Starts the Creation-Match in a Glass-Disk when biological pipes are blocked, tagging the mother in later.
cards.lore: Unlocked the Secret-of-Conception, giving the Gift-of-Life to those whose natural arenas were closed.
cards.gradeReason: Life-Starter is warm and clear; IVF pioneer Robert Edwards less known than the procedure itself.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Heron scientist in lab coat gently sparking glowing cell in glass dish, cosmic new life erupting from it. Mood: Quiet miracle, creation.

cards.power: The Herbal-Recall. Searches Ancient-Chinese-Scrolls to find a Plant-Weapon that kills malaria when modern drugs fail.
cards.lore: Bridged Ancient-Wisdom and Modern-Science, proving past Arena-Secrets are still powerful.
cards.gradeReason: Ancient-Healer role is clear; Tu Youyou less universally known — artemisinin story is the hook.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Red panda scholar in robes holding green glowing leaf against purple malaria monster, ancient scrolls behind. Mood: Traditional wisdom triumphant.

cards.power: The Instructions-Beam. Seeds a Messenger-Scroll telling the wrestler's own cells how to build the shield.
cards.lore: Turned the body into a Vaccine-Factory. Hacked Protein-Translation to win the Pandemic-Brawl.
cards.gradeReason: Post-COVID, mRNA vaccines are universal knowledge — Architect name makes the role instantly clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Colorful bird scientist sending glowing mRNA strand into cell nucleus, shield proteins erupting from cell wall. Mood: Pandemic triumph, instructions becoming life.

cards.power: The Soul-and-Body-Merge. Teaches that the Wrestler's Mind must be healthy for the body to heal; diet over aggressive bleeding.
cards.lore: The bridge between Medieval-Theology and Rational-Clinical-Observation, treating the Whole-Human.
cards.gradeReason: Balanced is clear but Maimonides needs Medieval context — holistic philosophy role is performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Camel sage sitting cross-legged balancing heart and brain on golden scales in candlelit medieval library. Mood: Holistic equilibrium.

cards.power: The Green-Pharmacy. Maps the Healing-Power of hundreds of plants and stones during a time of Spiritual-Daze.
cards.lore: Combined Mystical-Vision with Practical-Botany, keeping the Flame-of-Knowledge alive in monasteries.
cards.gradeReason: Visionary is evocative but Hildegard von Bingen needs context to separate mystic from herbalist.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Dark deer-eared figure in monk's habit in moonlit forest surrounded by glowing plants and mushrooms. Mood: Mystical botanical knowledge.

cards.power: The Tool-Maker. Invents the scalpel and forceps still used today, turning Barbaric-Cutting into precision surgery.
cards.lore: First to Stitch-the-Inside with dissolving Catgut, allowing for Deep-Arena-Repairs.
cards.gradeReason: Surgical-Father is clear but Al-Zahrawi needs Islamic Golden Age orientation — tools land immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Woodpecker craftsman in workshop displaying wall of gleaming surgical instruments in medieval Islamic style. Mood: Artisanal precision, foundational craft.

cards.power: The Parasite-Finder. Predicts disease is carried by Invisible-Seeds on clothing and air long before microscopes.
cards.lore: The Prophet-of-the-Infection. Guessed the Match-Rules of contagion centuries early.
cards.gradeReason: Germ-Prophet is the weakest name — Fracastoro is obscure, prophet role is descriptive not performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Bat flying over sleeping patients, invisible seed particles drifting through dark medieval bedroom. Mood: Prophetic dread, invisible enemy.

cards.power: The Rigor-Wall. Shuts down training arenas lacking Scientific-Manuals, creating the Modern-Doctor-Knights.
cards.lore: Standardized medical education, moving it into the University-and-Lab away from Apprentice-Guesswork.
cards.gradeReason: Standard-Setter is clear but the Flexner Report's cultural weight needs brief orientation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Bulldog inspector in suit demolishing crumbling medical school building, gleaming hospital rising behind. Mood: Reform, institutional reckoning.

cards.power: The Arena-Orchestrator. Coordinates the Match-Plan for the entire world, fighting Pandemic-Monsters across borders.
cards.lore: The Global-Safety-Net. Ensures Health-Stats are tracked and Vaccine-Shields delivered globally.
cards.gradeReason: Global-Ref is perfect — WHO as referee coordinating all arenas worldwide is instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Blue whale orbiting glowing Earth, red cross and vaccine symbols scattered across continents. Mood: Planetary coordination, global health authority.

cards.power: The Clinical-Closeness. Pulls Student-Rookies out of the lecture hall, forcing them to Listen-to-the-Patient.
cards.lore: He who studies without patients does not go to sea at all. The creator of modern clinical rounds.
cards.gradeReason: Bedside-Teacher is clear but Osler is a physician's legend — needs brief setup for general audiences.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Walrus professor in white coat at hospital bedside surrounded by attentive dog-student residents. Mood: Clinical wisdom passed down.

cards.power: The Mercy-Sanctuary. A Neutral-Symbol protecting healers in the War-Arena, ensuring the wounded are always treated.
cards.lore: Proved humanity must exist even in combat chaos. Turned Medical-Mercy into Global-Law.
cards.gradeReason: Red Cross is the most universally recognized humanitarian symbol — Neutral-Shield is instantly embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: St. Bernard dog with red cross vest standing in burning battlefield, glowing shield protecting wounded around it. Mood: Defiant mercy amid war.

cards.power: The Stetho-Inference. Uses a rolled paper tube to Hear-the-Valve-Clicks, inventing internal sound tracking.
cards.lore: Allowed us to hear the Internal-Soundtrack of the heart and lungs for the first time.
cards.gradeReason: Heart-Listener is beautiful but Laënnec as inventor of stethoscope needs a brief setup beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Deer doctor pressing paper tube against glowing holographic heart, sound waves visualized in neon green. Mood: First listening, intimate diagnostic.

cards.power: The Rhythe-Writer. Records the Electrical-Signals of the heart-engine onto a Paper-Scroll.
cards.lore: Birth of Electrocardiography. Gave the Electrical-Ghost of the heart a physical body we could study.
cards.gradeReason: Electric-Grapher is intriguing but EKG/ECG is specialist — paper scroll metaphor bridges it well.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Electric eel in bathtub wired to paper-rolling machine printing heart rhythm trace. Mood: Clinical electricity, rhythm made visible.

cards.power: The First-Minute-Scan. A 5-point check to see if the Newborn-Rookie is ready for the arena or needs a jumpstart.
cards.lore: Transformed neonatal care. Ensured no baby wrestler was ignored in the critical first minutes of life.
cards.gradeReason: APGAR score is known in parenting/medical circles — Newborn-Scorer role is crisp and immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Robin nurse holding stopwatch over newborn chick glowing with green 10-score, clinical care in focus. Mood: Urgent tender evaluation.

cards.power: The Molecular-Scanner. Builds a Magnetic-Bunker to see if Cancer-Miners have different water-signals than healthy cells.
cards.lore: The experimental pioneer who proved Nuclear Magnetic Resonance could find hidden monsters in the body.
cards.gradeReason: Tumor-Seeker is clear but Damadian's role is specialist — MRI pioneer story needs brief orientation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Mole scientist in full-body MRI tunnel surrounded by glowing cancer cell radar pulses. Mood: Deep molecular scanning, hidden monster hunting.

cards.power: The Research-Shield. Declares Human-Wrestlers must never be forced into a match and must give voluntary consent.
cards.lore: The ethical rebirth after the darkest Heel-Turn in history. Put the Human-Soul back into the science machine.
cards.gradeReason: Code-of-Fire is instantly embodiable — the ethical firewall. Everyone understands its moral weight.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Lion roaring before burning stone tablet, consent document glowing gold in war-crimes aftermath. Mood: Ethical rebirth from horror.

cards.power: The Trust-Destroyer. A dark chapter where doctors hid the cure to watch wrestlers suffer, creating a permanent trust gap.
cards.lore: The tragic reminder that Science-without-Ethics is a monster. Directly led to the Belmont protections.
cards.gradeReason: Shadow-Match is unflinching — you play the betrayal to understand why ethics codes exist. Necessary card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Wolf in suit holding treatment bag behind back while patient reaches through broken glass. Mood: Betrayal, dark chapter, systemic harm.

cards.power: The Conscience-Call. Publishes a List-of-Shame, showing elite arenas breaking shields for Data-Tokens.
cards.lore: Forced the creation of IRB-Gatekeepers to ensure every match plan is checked for morality before it starts.
cards.gradeReason: Whistleblower role is universally understood; Beecher himself less known — the act defines the card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Blue jay blowing whistle on lecture podium, research institute wall shattering to reveal list of names. Mood: Moral courage, institutional exposure.

cards.power: The Triple-Shield. Sets final rules: respect the wrestler, do good, treat fairly.
cards.lore: The Universal-Armor of the human subject. The moral code guiding every research match in the modern world.
cards.gradeReason: Triple-Shield is elegant but Belmont Report is specialist knowledge — the three shields need table naming.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Eagle spreading wings over three golden shields inscribed Mind, Body, Fairness, rabbit and squirrel sheltered beneath. Mood: Protective ethical order.

cards.power: The Wisdom-Orchestrator
cards.lore: Respect the ancestors, but never stop dissecting the dogma! Stay fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: MC host card — instantly performable as the arena's connective tissue.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor. Subject: Yellow rabbit MC with goggles holding lantern aloft amid floating ancestor masks and scrolls. Mood: Irreverent wisdom, temporal custodian.

cards.power: Quest: A 13th-century wrestler has a fever. The Galen-Manual demands Blood-Letting.
cards.lore: Combo Play: Use the Empirical-Method to demand Evidence before draining the wrestler! (Evidence vs. Blood-letting).
cards.gradeReason: Quest format needs table orientation but scenario logic is clear once you hold the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor comic panel. Subject: Galen-boar demanding bloodletting vs evidence magnifying glass stopping him. Mood: Historical clash of paradigms.

cards.power: Quest: 19th-century mothers are dying. Semmelweis screams about Dirty-Hands, but Referees mock him.
cards.lore: Combo Play: Combine Lister's Antiseptic-Mist with Pasteur's Germ-Theory to prove the Referees wrong and win the arena!
cards.gradeReason: Semmelweis-being-mocked is immediately compelling — the injustice drives the quest perfectly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor comic panel. Subject: Badger-Semmelweis washing hands while fox and bulldog referees gesture dismissal, germ cloud behind. Mood: Truth vs. establishment mockery.

cards.power: Quest: A 21st-century child has a Genetic-Glitch that will crash their muscle-engine.
cards.lore: Combo Play: Combine the Double-Helix-Scroll (Watson/Crick) with Genetic-Scissors (Doudna) to Edit the Code and save the match!
cards.gradeReason: CRISPR-as-scissors is universally understood post-COVID era — instant embodiment, save the child.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: MedKayfab watercolor comic panel. Subject: Cat-Doudna's scissors cutting glowing DNA strand while monkey-Watson/Crick hold the scroll steady. Mood: Precision genetic rescue.

verdict: Ancestral Arena drops 52 historical heavyweights plus Doc FrizzleBob and three Temporal Quests — and a full 50% fire at G1 with zero deadweight. The hyphenated-archetype naming system is at peak form: Galen-the-Dogma-King, Tus-kegee-the-Shadow-Match, and Semmel-the-Wash-Outcast are deck-defining moments that invite pure performance. Weakness: the G2 half leans on obscure pioneers whose names don't self-decode (Fracas, Einthov, Lauter), and some power/lore text blocks are dense for fast table reads. One factual flag: card 46 labels Einthoven's invention 'First EEG' — it's ECG. Table-ready? Yes.
blurb: From Imhotep's first patient record to Karikó's mRNA breakthrough — 56 figures from medicine's ancestral arena, each named to embody, each ready to fight. For students, educators, and anyone who's ever asked who actually figured this stuff out.
